entries.name: Bench Dip
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft, in the source's beginner set-up: hands on the edge of a bench behind, knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hips just clear of the bench edge. The hips travel straight down and back up close to the bench while the elbows bend straight back to about a right angle and no further, then press to long arms. Not drawn: the later progression to straight legs.
entries.summary: Hands on the edge of a bench behind you and knees bent, bend the elbows straight back to lower through a comfortable range, then press to long arms with the hips close to the bench.

frames.caption: Grip the edge of a stable bench behind you, bend the knees, and keep the hips just clear of the edge.
Bend the elbows straight back and lower only through the range the shoulders can hold comfortably.
Elbows point straight back. Shoulders down, away from the ears.
Press to long arms while keeping the hips close to the bench.
Hips graze the bench the whole way.

entries.name: Dip
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 28 degrees so both parallel bars, the suspended body supported on straight arms with packed shoulders, and the descent until the upper arms are parallel to the floor all read clearly: supporting the body on parallel bars with straight arms, bending the elbows to lower until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor, and pressing back up to straight arms.
entries.summary: Supporting yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders down away from the ears, bend your elbows to lower your body until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, then press back up to straight arms.

frames.caption: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight and shoulders packed down away from the ears.
Bend your elbows and lower your body under control, leaning slightly forward for more chest or staying upright for more triceps.
Lower to a stretch you can press out of until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up from the bottom while keeping the shoulders down away from the ears.
Lock out tall on the parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders packed.
